phase_text.pick_approach: Move above the grasp point on the wire, fingers open.
phase_text.pick_descend: Guarded touch-down: lower until the fingertips feel the board (1.5 N), then back off 1.5 mm.
phase_text.pick_close: Close on the wire and check the opening matches the wire's diameter.
phase_text.route_lift: Lift the held wire so it cannot drag across the fork posts.
phase_text.route_transit: Sweep around the last fixed point with the wire nearly taut, over the fork.
phase_text.route_descend: Lower past the fork, keeping the wire tension between 2.5 and 6 N: move away when it goes slack, give way when it pulls.
phase_text.route_seat: Ramp the tension to 10 N, centre the wire over the slot from perception, wiggle until it snaps past the barbs.
phase_text.route_release: Open, lift, and check the wire stayed in the slot.
phase_text.connector_tip: The connector stands on its end: pull it over by its wire.
phase_text.connector_relocate: Move the connector to a clear spot where the fingers can reach around it.
phase_text.connector_approach: Move above the connector, turned to match it.
phase_text.connector_transit: Carry it behind the holder so the wire leaves through the back slot.
phase_text.connector_descend: Guarded descent until the connector touches (about 2 N).
phase_text.connector_search: Spiral search, pushing down with 3 N, until the connector drops into the pocket.
phase_text.connector_press: Press with 6 N and a small wiggle until the latch clicks.
phase_text.connector_release: Open, back off, and check the connector is seated.
phase_text.retreat: Move the arm out of the camera's view.
phase_text.disturbance: Nothing: the robot holds still while the disturbance happens.
phase_text.learned_policy: GR00T N1.7 drives the arm: from the two camera images, the robot's state and the instruction it outputs the next motions, 20 times a second.
phase_text.route_realign: Seating assist: the wire lies on a prong, so lift it clear and line the gripper up with the route again.
